description: agent.create is the write that mints a first-party agent row from name/description/functionality — a daemon write, not PL15 policy authoring (it touches the agent table, not the closed policy set), so it is registered like loop.create rather than the human-only door. The result is the created row, so the caller holds the identity it just made; the CLI and the app share this one surface (P34).
